en: A black and white photographic postcard depicting a large, traditional German mountain lodge-style building in a snowy landscape. The front caption reads 'FELDBERG (Schwarzwald).' and 'No. 382. Feldbergerhof.' There is handwritten text both around the image and on the back. The back features a green stamp from the Deutsches Reich and a postal mark reading 'FELDBERG'. The address is to someone in Freiburg, Germany.
